bagPolicy.summary: When We Were Young does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: The festival is taking 2026 off and has announced a return to Las Vegas in October 2027. Use the official site for that edition's bag and prohibited-item rules.

parking.note: The festival is taking 2026 off and has announced a return to Las Vegas in October 2027. Review the official site for the returning edition's transportation and parking plan.

rideshare.note: Uber and Lyft ride-share services are available, with pick-up and drop-off near the main entrance.

concessions.note: The venue offers a variety of quick-serve food and drink options, including gourmet coffees and pastries at Starbucks, fresh doughnuts at Krispy Kreme, and Italian gelato at Cocolini. Guests can also enjoy classic fast-food offerings from Popeyes and Dairy Queen, as well as Asian cuisine from Pick Up Stix.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by When We Were Young, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in When We Were Young's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at When We Were Young. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at When We Were Young. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
